'''Mewvorr''' were a diminutive, domesticated, version of the larger predatory [[mawvorr]]. Mewvorrs were often kept as pets during the time of the [[Galactic War]], and their popularity was such that many different breeds existed. Some owners also took to selling [[Cyborg/Legends|cybernetically enhanced]] versions as well. Known breeds included aquatic, flameshell, goldplate, heatglow, prismatic, and woodland, whilst cyborg breeds included cyberlamp, cyberglow, and cyberlight.
